dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Tuberculous pericardial effusion, status post pericardiocentesis

Alternatives to still consider:
1. Idiopathic (viral) pericardial effusion
2. Malignant pericardial effusion (e.g., metastatic carcinoma or lymphoma)
3. Autoimmune/connective tissue disease–related pericardial effusion (e.g., SLE, rheumatoid)
